pipeline_name: New Administration Capital PS Gas Pipeline

validity.recommendation: sheet wrong (incomplete) — set StartYear1=2018, ref via 'Start [ref]'
validity.researcher_notes: The sheet's own existing ref (petro-news.com/95212) describes this exact segment ('32-inch feeding line, 63 km, cost 327M EGP') as built 'within the urgent plan to supply the Siemens [New Administrative Capital] power station with natural gas' — but that source carries no date, and the row has no StartYear1 despite Status=operating. Independently verified two convergent, independent sources: (1) Youm7 (2016-04-03) reports GASCO began implementing the gas lines/pressure-reduction stations for the three Siemens power stations (Beni Suef, Burullus, New Administrative Capital) with a stated ~2-year target ('during the coming two years'), i.e. targeting completion ~2018; (2) The Energy Year's July 2019 interview with GASCO chairman Yasser Salah El Din states verbatim: 'In 2018, GASCO implemented several projects in the gas grid with a total length of 130 kilometres including projects to supply Siemens' power plants with natural gas' — an independent English-language trade-press source naming 2018 as the completion year for exactly this project class. A third source, the Egyptian Presidency's official project page, confirms the New Administrative Capital power station itself (the plant this line exclusively feeds) finished construction/commissioning in May 2018, which the gas feeder line had to precede or coincide with for the plant to run on gas. No source names this specific 63km/32in segment by name with an exact month, so I am staging StartYear1=2018 at tier=medium (converging independent evidence, not a segment-specific dated citation) rather than a firm high-confidence date. Do not guess a month — none of the three sources gives one for this specific line.

fills.researcher_notes: StartYear1 fill of 2018 for this Egypt-only, plant-dedicated feeder line, based on convergence of: GASCO began construction of the Siemens-power-station gas supply lines in 2016 with a ~2-year target (Youm7, 2016-04-03); GASCO's chairman stating in a July 2019 trade-press interview that the Siemens power-plant gas-supply package (of which this line, per the sheet's own petro-news ref, is explicitly part) was completed in 2018; and the New Administrative Capital power station itself (the sole offtaker of this pipeline) finishing construction in May 2018 per Egypt's official Presidency project page. No source states an exact month for this specific 63km segment — do not treat 2018 as more precise than a year-level inference from the surrounding project timeline. Not a duplicate/orphan-ref fill: StartYearEarliest is a computed/formula field and was intentionally left untouched per repo convention (only StartYear1 + Start [ref] staged).

summary: Flag confirmed: StartYear1 was genuinely blank for an operating pipeline; staged StartYear1=2018 (tier medium, 2 independent corroborating sources — GASCO chairman trade interview + Youm7 2016 construction-start report + presidency.eg plant-completion date) since no single source names this exact 63km segment's month; nothing left UNRESOLVED.
